name: com.realreturnengine/real-return-engine
title: Real Return Engine
description: 7-year expected real and nominal returns for Cash, Bonds, and S&P 500 (1928-2026 backtest).

tools.name: get_cross_asset_7y_forecast
tools.description: Returns 7-year expected annualized real (after-inflation) and nominal returns (%/yr), current real yields, ETF proxy tickers (BIL, SHV, SGOV, IEF, GOVT, TLT, LQD, VCIT, SPY, VOO, IVV), and return-basis assumptions across US Cash (3-Month Treasury Bill), 10-Year US Government Bonds, Investment-Grade Corporate Bonds (Moody's Baa), and the S&P 500 under four valuation frameworks: Post-1990 Baseline, 100-Year Baseline, Robert Shiller 10-Year Government Bond CAPE (Excess CAPE Yield / ECY), and Standard Raw Shiller CAPE (cyclically adjusted P/E ratio).

tools.name: get_100yr_backtest_summary
tools.description: Returns 100-year historical out-of-sample forecast accuracy metrics (1928-2026 evaluation window, 100-Year Mean Absolute Error, Post-1990 Mean Absolute Error, and Pearson correlation r across 92 completed 7-year periods) plus historical market turning-point snapshots comparing expected vs. realized 7-year real returns at the 1982 Interest Rate Peak, 2000 Dot-Com Bubble Peak, 2009 Financial Crisis Low, and Live 2026.

tools.name: explain_methodology
tools.description: Returns a plain-English explanation of the 7-year cross-asset valuation mean-reversion and carry methodology, CPI inflation adjustment, the difference between the four S&P 500 valuation baselines (Post-1990 Margin Baseline, 100-Year Baseline, Shiller 10Y Gov Bond Excess CAPE Yield, and Standard Raw CAPE), fixed-income term and credit spread normalization, and the 1928-2026 out-of-sample backtest verification protocol.

topic.description: Optional specific topic to explain: 'all', 'equities_cape', 'fixed_income_bonds_cash', 'real_vs_nominal_inflation', or 'backtest_1928_2026'.

tools.name: request_missing_asset_or_feature
tools.description: Logs a request for an asset class, ETF ticker (such as QQQ, TLT, HYG, IWM, VXUS, TIPS, Gold, REITs, international equities, or crypto), custom time horizon (5-year, 10-year, 20-year, 30-year), or portfolio allocation calculator (60/40 portfolio, retirement withdrawal, glidepath) not listed in the 7 core rows, and returns the closest currently available building-block proxy.

requested_item.description: The ticker, asset class, metric, or feature requested (e.g., 'QQQ', 'TLT', 'HYG', '60/40 portfolio', '10-year horizon').

user_context.description: Brief summary of what the user is trying to compare or solve.
